pr_title: Support "extends" in tsconfig.json, and add shared TypeScript utils
pr_body:
Fixes #2856. Fixes #3710. Closes #2269.

This adds support for the `extends` field in tsconfig.json by using the TypeScript API to load configs rather than our own loader. We track all extended configs so they are watched for changes as well.

To support this across all three plugins we have for TypeScript, I've created a `@parcel/ts-utils` package with some utilities for dealing with the TS API. It handles bindings to the Parcel FileSystem instead of native Node FS, tracking files read so we can watch them, etc. There is also a util to load a `tsconfig.json` with the TypeScript API.

The only plugin we aren't using this in yet is the validator, which doesn't have support for `loadConfig` in core yet. Once that happens, we can swap it out there too.

comments: Thanks so much for the detailed repro! Should be fixed by #3712.

@lindskogen I think this is a separate issue. We don't support `extends` in `tsconfig` yet. If you copy and paste the config from the outer tsconfig in your project into the inner one instead it works. I'll work on supporting extends in a separate PR.
Oh, I didn't know that. Thank you for your time and quick reply!
